methodology.variantA: Actual production engine with capitalAllowance=true, headsUpFaceBidWeight=0.3, wordFirst=true; no additional larger-table premium
methodology.variantB: Same production engine/options as A; only positive nonterminal N>=3 Vickrey bids receive the extra face.1 final transform
methodology.opponentCaveat: Public-data-inspired stress archetypes, not reconstructions of actual rivals. Three original starters use the same reliable external driver.
methodology.setup: Actual team/credential creation, registration, start, all Swiss, top cut, elimination and three-game final/crown reducers. No phase or status shortcuts.
methodology.lifecycle: One owned optimizer per bot across all matches. Measured A/B use a shared immutable ProductionDictionary; all17 opponents retain the separate shared FrozenDictionary and frozen policies. Both indexes use official wordlist order; only starters have a longest-first copy. Fresh policies/database per paired variant/tournament.
methodology.inputs: Own authenticated myRack only; public balances/auction/history; actual per-table participant count, including 6,5,4,3,2.
methodology.scheduler: Words/bids for every table in the next common closing group finish before advancing the clock once. Only precollected due tables tick; automatic next Swiss deals remain inside the final prior-round reducer. Event loop yields only after each completed deadline group, without changing simulated time or RNG/action order.
methodology.rng: Seed before initial start, each actual phase/round/table-slot/window tick, and each required manual finals start. Later RNG tile streams can diverge between A/B as actions change.
methodology.measuredPosition: Rotates position%18 within each batch; same seed and position across A/B. A six-seed pilot covers only positions0–5;18/36-seed batches cover all positions once/twice.

executionOrder.rule: A-first always runs A then B. Balanced runs B first iff(i+floor(i/18))%2===1, reversing each candidate position's order at i+18. Variants execute sequentially.

methodology.scoreAndPlace: Swiss rank captured at cut before later scores; non-cut overall place derived from Swiss rank, serverFinalFinishPosition remains null. Crown uses three final scores, then whole-tournament total, then lower id.
methodology.terminal: All entrants external; existing rack may cash before last close, no policy/action after final award. bagTotal0 bids suppressed by driver.
methodology.timing: Actual production wordFirst=true decision profile on both measured sides: return word/bid0 before augmented search, then reprice after confirmed reducer/rack changes. Synchronous wall time >100ms remains the offline guard, separate from production 150ms IPC/transport gate.
methodology.limitations: Fixed archetype mix and finite paired sample do not prove live tournament strength. Word-first skips augmented-cache work and can change later approximate solves, so both measured sides use the same production profile. Wall-clock bounded searches can differ near deadlines. Opponents remain frozen; no worker/network tests here.
methodology.promotion: Report only; independent format experiment. The failed six-player primary score gate remains unchanged; criteria and confirmation must be separately predeclared.
